newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound calls 10 pct senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound calls 10 pct senior notes.

text.p: Greyhound LInes Inc said Wednesday that it has issued a notice of redemption to holders of its ten percent senior notes due 2001. The date fixed for redemption is May 20, said the company, an the senior notes will be redeemed at 105 percent of their principal amount, together with accrued and unpaid interest to, but not including, the date set for redemption.
Greyhound also said Wednesday that it has completed two private offerings of its securities.

The company said it has issued $150 million aggregate principal amount of a new class of 11.5 percent senior notes due 2007 and $60 million liquidation preference of a new class of 8.5 percent convertible exchangeable preferred stock. In addition, said the company, up to $9 million liquidation preference of the preferred stock is available for issuance solely to cover over-allotments, if any.
